articles.title: Anthropic Q3 revenue surges 45% to $16.8 billion as AI startup gears up for $2 trillion IPO
articles.description: Anthropic reported a 45% increase in revenue for the third quarter, reaching $16.8 billion. The company's revenue for the first and second quarters was $4.7 billion and $11.6 billion, respectively. Anthropic aims for a valuation exceeding $2 trillion, emphasizing substantial revenue growth despite significant operational losses. Founded by former OpenAI executives, the company focuses on AI safety amid growing competition.

articles.title: Can AI feel safer than human advice for consumers who face discrimination?
articles.description: What should you cook for dinner on a budget of 20 euros when you have a guest with a gluten intolerance? A shopper might ask a shop assistant for advice or consult, for example, Hopla, the AI-powered shopping assistant launched by French supermarket chain Carrefour. Behind this everyday choice lies a broader question: when faced with a recommendation, who do we trust more? A human being or an AI?
